feeds.title: Careershifters Blog
feeds.description: Expert guidance, inspiration, and practical help for your career change on our blog. Life's too short to be unhappy at work. We help bright, motivated people who feel stuck in the wrong career find and move into fulfilling work.

feeds.title: Midlife Unstuck Blog
feeds.description: Read midlife career change articles. I'm Lucia Knight. I'm a midlifer who has gone through several career transformations so I know a bit about them. I now combine my head-hunting, management, coaching, and psychology experience to help other midlifers to design their work future in a way that fits and feels much better than their current work.

feeds.title: Career Change Guide Blog
feeds.description: Career Change Guide's author, Michael B. Schoettle, uses his experience, to show how people get jobs and the importance of being both qualified for the job and fitting well with the values and culture of the people where they work. Go through their blog and learn more about their books, reviews, resources, articles, and more.

feeds.title: The Career Changers
feeds.description: Looking for a career change? Discover career change resources, read inspirational stories, and find help during your career change journey. The Careers Changers it's an online community that aims to inspire and celebrate people during their journey to self-realization. We support people that want/need to change careers but feel stuck or lack confidence and clarity, by providing exclusive content from the best career and life coaches in the world.

feeds.title: Career Change Coach Blog
feeds.description: Accredited career coach, Caroline Wellingham, looking to inspire, motivate and encourage women to achieve their career dreams, goals, and ambitions.

feeds.title: Easy Career Change
feeds.description: Welcome to Easy Career Change where you can find blogs about what alternative jobs might fit you best while still being related to the skills you have already developed! Our articles are written by industry professionals that have researched what careers could be a good fit for you based on your current position.

feeds.title: Landing Jobs » Career Change
feeds.description: This section of Landing Jobs focuses on articles related to Career Change. Landing Jobs is a candidate-driven tech careers marketplace. We've dedicated ourselves to matchmaking great tech talent with great opportunities. Our mission is to build nothing less than the top destination for tech professionals who want to advance their careers.
